words.prose: {{ar:أَثَرْنَ}} ({{tr:atharna}}) is the first finite consequence verb in the sequence: the feminine plural ending keeps the same unspoken agents from 100:1-3, while the perfect form turns their described motion into a completed event. As a Form I verb, it keeps agency direct: the subjects themselves raise the medium, rather than merely causing another process to do so. Its direct object, {{ar:نَقْعًا}} ({{tr:naqʿan}}), prevents the verb from being only motion; the charge produces a raised medium. The broader {{ar:أ ث ر}} ({{tr:ʾ-th-r}}) field of trace and aftermath remains useful here because the local stirring is contact that leaves evidence in the air and on the ground, though the object keeps the active sense narrowed to raising dust. That makes this a marked oath-scene deployment of the broader root family, not just a routine recurrence of the root. The reported intensified reading {{ar:فَأَثَّرْنَ}} ({{tr:fa-aththarna}}) does not replace the base parse, but it exposes the same imprinting pressure, and the clipped connector plus sharp hamza onset makes the move into finite action audible. Across the boundary, the prior raid presses downward into the target and the ground answers upward as dust. Structurally, the verb pairs with the next finite feminine plural consequence verb in 100:5: dust is raised before the same feminine plural agents enter the gathering.

words.prose: {{ar:بِهِ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) is the compact hinge between the verb and its result. The bāʾ governs the attached masculine singular pronoun, but the antecedent is not forced: it can gather the dawn of 100:3, a place or event, the charge itself, or the whole prior sequence as the means or setting by which dust is raised. That unresolved pronoun matters because the acting subjects are feminine plural, so the phrase does not simply point back to them. Its position before {{ar:نَقْعًا}} ({{tr:naqʿan}}) delays the visible object and makes mediation arrive before the final dust-cloud. words.prose: {{ar:نَقْعًا}} ({{tr:naqʿan}}) is the object the verb produces, so the ayah ends not with motion itself but with the medium thrown into the scene. Its indefinite accusative form presents the result as an unbounded mass rather than a counted thing, and its final position after {{ar:بِهِ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) gives the dust-cloud the clause's sensory landing. The root is a Quranic hapax here, so this occurrence has to carry its lexical range locally. V4 confirms raised dust as an accepted branch, while the supplied soaking and cry branches should not displace the local dust reading; they thicken it as permeation and clamor, making the air feel filled rather than merely sprinkled. In the opening oath sequence, this raised medium also makes the filling pattern explicit: breath, sparks, dawn light, and now dust or sound successively occupy the scene. Its nasal onset, deep qaf, and ʿayn closure give the word a heavy inward sound texture that suits a dense, obscuring medium. The final tanwīn also ties the word to the opening oath cadence and points forward to the gathered body in 100:5, so the obscuring medium closes one beat and prepares the next.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Dust as displaced concealment.** Evidence: ث و ر B002 stirring something from settled state; ن ق ع B004 raised dust; و ر ي B005 covering/hiding; ق ب ر B002 hidden inward sinking. Structural cue: the sequence moves from hidden fire to raised dust, then later to opened graves. Role: ثور supplies the act of agitation; نقع supplies the visible medium lifted from the ground. Abductive move: the same force that exposes sparks also produces a screen of dust, so disclosure and obscuration co-occur. Reading change: the ayah reads as a paradoxical unveiling that also veils.

2. **Resurrection rehearsal.** Evidence: ث و ر B001 bursting up after stillness; ب ع ث ر B001 upturning buried contents; ق ب ر B001 graves; ح ص ل B001 resolving/revealing. Structural cue: a raised cloud from earth appears before the explicit eschatological upturning in 100:9. Role: dust is a preliminary sign of the ground's contents being disturbed. Abductive move: military dust becomes an image-scale rehearsal for the later cosmic excavation. Reading change: 100:4 is not only battlefield atmosphere; it anticipates earth giving up what was settled within it.

3. **Noise becoming social alarm.** Evidence: ن ق ع B005 raised/sustained cry; ض ب ح B001 breath-sound; ص ب ح B004 morning alarm; ش ه د B008 visible sign. Structural cue: sound begins with animal breath, then the raid at morning implies alarm, then dust becomes a visible sign. Role: نقع as cry converts particulate disturbance into communicative disturbance. Abductive move: the dust cloud and sound together warn the gathered group before impact. Reading change: the ayah becomes an alarm event: the raid raises both matter and public awareness.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: 100:9 was the strongest later surprise: بعثر القبور made the dust of 100:4 a miniature grave-disturbance. 100:10 then corrected the dust reading by showing that raised matter alone is incomplete; what must finally rise is the inward remainder.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Stored bodily force becomes directed motion, audible strain, a raised trace, and penetration into a gathered body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The charge is legible not only as displacement but through breath, alarm, dust, and the gathering of separate strides into momentum.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Dawn Assault and Alarm
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A hostile movement arrives in the morning while repeated cries announce the assault and orient it toward an opposing group.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: wrongful incursion (`ع د و:B001/m01`); enemy relation (`ع د و:B003/m01`); morning assault (`ص ب ح:B004/m01`); alarm cry (`ص ب ح:B004/m02`); raised repeated cry (`ن ق ع:B005/m01`); gathered host (`ج م ع:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The morning is both the time of attack and the setting for an alarm. Hostility gives the movement its social target, while the repeated cry turns the incursion into a publicly perceived event.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Stored bodily force becomes directed motion, audible strain, a raised trace, and penetration into a gathered body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The charge is legible not only as displacement but through breath, alarm, dust, and the gathering of separate strides into momentum.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Dust Plume and Center Penetration
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Rapid movement agitates settled earth, raises a dust plume, and carries the movers into the middle of an assembled group.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: stirring earth from place (`ث و ر:B002/m01`); raised dust (`ن ق ع:B004/m01`); entry into the middle (`و س ط:B003/m01`); assembled group (`ج م ع:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Agitation produces the visible dust outcome, while entry into the middle completes the spatial process: movement begins outside the group and terminates inside its center.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water settles into receptive ground, develops a layered surface, and then moves into bodies or vessels as drink.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Cloud, algae, bubbles, and quenching describe successive positions above, upon, and within gathered water.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Lowland Catchment and Abundant Water
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Soft low ground receives water, a pool holds it in place, and the collected volume becomes a well, sea, or abundant sweet resource.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: soft low catchment (`خ ب ر:B002/m01`); standing pool (`ن ق ع:B001/m01`); abundant or sweet water (`ر ب ب:B013/m01`); sea or water-rich well (`ع ل م:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Receptive terrain is the setting, settling is the process, and abundant stored water is the outcome. The well and sea senses scale the same collection principle from bounded source to immense body.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water settles into receptive ground, develops a layered surface, and then moves into bodies or vessels as drink.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Cloud, algae, bubbles, and quenching describe successive positions above, upon, and within gathered water.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cloud, Film, Bubble, and Wave
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Moisture gathers above as layered cloud and upon water as algae, bubbles, ripples, or waves.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rising cloud or water spread (`ث و ر:B001/m02`); algae on the surface (`ث و ر:B007/m01`); bubbles and water tracks (`ح ب ب:B008/m01`); layered rain cloud (`ر ب ب:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The motifs form a vertical surface system: cloud layers hold moisture above, algae rests on the water, and bubbles or waves articulate motion across its face.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Quenching, Filling, and Departure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A drink is offered in the morning, thirst is quenched, body or vessel reaches fullness, and the drinker departs the water source.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: quenching thirst (`ن ق ع:B002/m01`); drinking to fullness (`ح ب ب:B006/m01`); morning drink (`ص ب ح:B003/m01`); departure from a watering place (`ص د ر:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Morning drink names the occasion, quenching names the bodily change, fullness marks completion, and departure closes the watering sequence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A receptacle gathers discrete contents and permits them to be stored, served, gripped, or drawn out.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same hand-to-container geometry connects jars and cups with the leather holder and hand-drawn shafts used for lots.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Storage and Serving Vessels
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Liquids or food are held in a soaking vessel, large skin, jar, pot, and drinking cup, then made available for use.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: bounded soaking place or vessel (`ن ق ع:B001/m02`); large waterskin (`خ ب ر:B004/m01`); storage jar (`ح ب ب:B007/m01`); large pot (`ج م ع:B012/m01`); drinking cup (`ق د ح:B006/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The vessels differ in scale and use but share one scene signature: contents are bounded, preserved, and positioned for soaking, storage, or serving.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Living material moves from seed and cultivated growth through separation and residue into food prepared for storage or hospitality.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The roots of love, testimony, lordship, and running extend into grain, honeycomb, plant care, and late-season herbage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Tilling, Watering, and Nurture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A cultivator stirs soil, supplies water and provisions, and raises the productive thing gradually toward completion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: soil stirring (`ث و ر:B002/m03`); cultivator and sharecropper (`خ ب ر:B003/m01`); provisioning or watering (`غ ي ر:B001/m01`); gradual nurture (`ر ب ب:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Soil disturbance prepares the setting, the cultivator supplies agency, watering sustains the process, and nurture names the gradual movement toward a finished crop.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Living material moves from seed and cultivated growth through separation and residue into food prepared for storage or hospitality.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The roots of love, testimony, lordship, and running extend into grain, honeycomb, plant care, and late-season herbage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Curd, Syrup, Honey, and Welcome Food
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Solid dairy, thick condiment, comb honey, milk, and slaughtered food are assembled into a prepared meal for arrival or hospitality.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dried-curd lump (`ث و ر:B005/m01`); thick syrup or paste (`ر ب ب:B006/m01`); honey in comb (`ش ه د:B007/m01`); welcome meal (`ن ق ع:B003/m01`); hospitality slaughter (`ن ق ع:B003/m02`); chilled pure milk (`ن ق ع:B003/m03`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The motifs occupy distinct food roles: curd is a solid staple, syrup a dressing, honey a sweet stored in wax, and milk or slaughtered meat the substance of a welcoming meal.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A living group persists through herd formation, reproductive stages, maturation, descent, and delegated care.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Herd vocabulary passes into human household structure through foster children, caretakers, grandchildren, and signs of maturity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cattle and Herd Cohort
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Bulls and other livestock form a bounded herd containing animals of different size and activity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: bull or male cattle (`ث و ر:B004/m01`); livestock herd (`ر ب ب:B014/m01`); grouped animals (`ج م ع:B002/m01`); small or lean animal (`ح ب ب:B010/m01`); camel remaining at its resting place (`ص ب ح:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The herd is the collective setting, the bull and small animal occupy differentiated member roles, and the resting camel adds a state of managed immobility within the cohort.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Knowing and Making Hidden States Legible
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Perception, testimony, signs, excavation, and extraction convert concealed states into knowable or manifest ones.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The disclosure pattern spans sensory recognition, speech, body marks, reflected images, graves, mineral casings, and the contents of chests.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Exhumation and Extraction
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Covered ground is agitated, a grave or hollow is opened, and a concealed body or valuable core is brought out.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: turning soil to uncover (`ب ع ث ر:B001/m01`); burial enclosure (`ق ب ر:B001/m01`); hidden hollow (`ق ب ر:B002/m01`); concealed thing (`و ر ي:B005/m01`); agitation that exposes (`ث و ر:B002/m02`); extracting a precious core (`ح ص ل:B002/m02`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Burial and concealment define the initial enclosure, agitation and turning break that enclosure, and extraction names the final transfer of hidden contents into view.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Relations between parties are bound as pacts, opposed as enmity, argued through claims, and restored through judgment or mediation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Roots used on the surface for running, gathering, and entering the middle become the roles of foe, ally, claimant, and mediator.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Defamation, Insult, and Displayed Anger
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Conflict is verbalized as lineage attack and coarse insult, while anger becomes visible in the face.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: defamation of lineage (`ق د ح:B003/m01`); coarse insult (`ن ق ع:B009/m01`); tongue as expression (`ش ه د:B005/m01`); nose-tip display of anger (`ق ب ر:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The tongue supplies the expressive tool, defamation and insult supply the hostile acts, and the angered face supplies their bodily counterpart.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Places are differentiated by hardness, level, edge, middle, facing, and the capacity to hold a body in position.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Valley banks and hard ground scale into a human-facing side, an opposite side beyond a barrier, and a body or cloud that remains fixed in place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Soft Basin, Flat Plain, and Hard Ground
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler or animal moves across a terrain gradient from soft depression through level clay to hard uneven and barren ground.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: soft low ground (`خ ب ر:B002/m01`); terrain depression (`ق ب ر:B002/m02`); level clay plain (`ن ق ع:B007/m01`); hard uneven ground (`ع د و:B010/m01`); barren soil (`ك ن د:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Softness and depression describe receptive ground, the plain removes vertical obstruction, hardness introduces resistance, and barrenness names the land's failed productive outcome.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The body contains hidden cores, presents identifying surfaces, and registers damage or illness through visible and transmissible changes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Eye and tongue represent the person, while moral interiority is given a physical counterpart in the heart's dark core and the contents of the chest.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Internal Disease, Contagion, and Poison
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Disease occupies lung or gut, passes between bodies, weakens an animal, and culminates in a fixed or killing poison.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: internal lung or gut disease (`و ر ي:B001/m01`); transmitted disease (`ع د و:B006/m01`); settled or killing poison (`ن ق ع:B006/m01`); sick camel immobilized (`ح ب ب:B005/m01`); emaciated horse or sunken eye (`ق د ح:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Internal disease supplies the originating condition, contagion supplies transmission, wasting and immobility supply bodily outcomes, and poison gives the process a concentrated lethal form.
